action.description: plan evaluates the safety checks, including the backend health of the frontend's rules, and reports the next step without changing anything. Each execute makes one change: it removes the frontend with its rules and probes (or deletes the load balancer if this was its last frontend and it has no backends), then, in a later execute, deletes the Service's public IP. Execute again while the result reports remaining: true.

loadBalancerId.description: Resource ID of the AKS load balancer (kubernetes or kubernetes-internal in the node resource group).

frontendName.description: Frontend IP configuration of the deleted Service: a followed by the first 31 hex digits of the Service UID without dashes. Confirm in the cluster that no Service has a UID starting with these digits first.

serviceName.description: namespace/name of the deleted Service, as in the k8s-azure-service tag of its public IP.
